note: Case ids the pipeline must NEVER add. Read by pipeline/update.py (load_blocklist) and checked in main() next to existing_ids: a listed id is excluded from analysis, from data/cases.json and from the data/state.json pending watchlist. This is NOT the scope filter - in_scope() judges classes of case; this file names individual decisions a human has looked at and ruled out. Every entry needs id, citation, caseName and reason. The id must be the canonical lowercase '<court>-<year>-<number>' form and must agree with the citation: the loader derives the id from the citation and STOPS THE RUN if they differ, if a field is missing, or if the JSON is broken - blocking the wrong id would silently drop a real criminal decision, so this file must be right or the run must stop. Delete an entry to let the case back in. A judgment you email in yourself (INGEST) overrides this file.
